summary: Validated (1) jury demo lockout-immunity bug fix and (2) homepage Voice Tour tryout feature. All 5 backend tests pass (jury login success, 12x wrong-password barrage all 401 never 429, correct password works immediately after barrage, db.login_attempts non-blocking for jury, non-demo synthetic email still hits 429 — so the bypass is correctly is_demo-scoped, not a global removal of brute-force protection). Frontend: section-voice-ai, home-voice-tryout, home-voice-mic-btn, home-voice-transcript all render unauthenticated; placeholder contains 'Add a new production order for 500 cookies'; clicking mic in Chromium without mic permission does not crash the page — widget stays mounted.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_login() now correctly looks up user FIRST, sets is_demo_account, and skips check_lockout/record_failed_login when is_demo_account=True. Logic is clean and the bypass remains scoped: any account without is_demo still passes through check_lockout → 429 after 5 fails within 15 min. Verified empirically.
is_demo is only set by seed_jury_demo() (not API-grantable) — secure.
VoiceTryout sub-component uses the shared useVoiceInput hook, gracefully handles unsupported browsers (Playwright Chromium without mic) without crashing — confirmed in browser test.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded jury demo + a throwaway non-demo email (nodemo_test@zynthoro-test.com) whose login_attempts row was cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter14 verified the jury lockout fix and homepage Voice Tour. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_jury_lockout.py is a regression suite — re-run on any future auth_login change. Did NOT re-run the full operations module suite per main-agent instruction (iter13 was clean). Voice tryout only verified element mounting + click-safe; actual Web Speech transcription cannot be exercised in headless Chromium.
rca of the issue: Original lockout was stale data from earlier QA brute-force runs against jury@zynthoro.ai. Fix: in server.py auth_login(), look up user document BEFORE calling check_lockout; if user.is_demo is truthy, skip both check_lockout and record_failed_login entirely. Verified with 12 consecutive wrong-password POSTs — all 401, never 429 — and a non-demo synthetic email confirmed to still hit 429, proving the bypass is is_demo-scoped only.
